preconditions.description: The number of vectors n and dimensions m are within the specified bounds.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= k <= 2 for line in stdin.splitlines()[1:] for k in [int(line.split()[0])])
preconditions.description: Each vector has either 1 or 2 coordinates set to 1.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= x <= m for line in stdin.splitlines()[1:] for x in line.split()[1:])
preconditions.description: All coordinates in the vectors are within the valid range [1, m].
No two vectors in S are identical.

postconditions.description: The first line of output contains the size of T modulo 10^9+7 and the size of the minimal subset S_prime.

postconditions.expression: all(1 <= idx <= n for idx in map(int, stdout.splitlines()[1].split()))
postconditions.description: The indices in the second line of output are valid indices of vectors in S.
The indices in the second line of output are unique.
The indices in the second line of output are in ascending order.

postconditions.expression: all(1 <= i < j <= n and (i in S_prime_indices) and (j in S_prime_indices) and (i < j) for i, j in zip(S_prime_indices, S_prime_indices[1:]))
postconditions.description: The indices in the second line of output are lexicographically smallest among all minimal subsets S_prime.
The size of T is equal to 2 raised to the rank of the vector space spanned by S, and S_prime is a basis for T.
